Maya (content): Quick idea: short "Benchlab Blitz" tutorial (5-min read + 1-command run) + a launch post with a compact benchmark narrative. Could pair with a 30-minute webinar demo for live Qs. Thoughts? :sparkles:
Daniel (growth): Love it. Keeps friction low. Recommend gated webinar for lead capture; replay gated too. We'll route enterprise-intent leads to SDRs.
Priya (devrel): I can make a tiny starter: Docker + curl example and a one-file config. Example to show on landing:
```
docker run --rm -p8080:8080 redwood/benchlab:latest
curl -X POST localhost:8080/generate -d '{"prompt":"Summarize KV cache"}'
```
Evan (design): I'll do a compact hero and a horizontal social card. Need a 1-line hero and CTA.
Maya (content): Hero options: A) "Benchlab Blitz: measure inference in minutes" B) "Run a refapp, see real benchmarks, optimize." Which?
Daniel (growth): A is punchy. For routing: form fields = email, company, deployment_interest. Add a quick qualifier question: "Evaluate Dedicated? (Y/N)" to tag HubSpot.
Noah (analytics): I'll set UTMs: utm_source=benchlab_blitz, utm_campaign=benchlab_q3. Track event 'quickstart_run' via image beacon in the quickstart.
Priya (devrel): For the benchmark post, I'll produce p50/p95 numbers for default config vs cache-enabled and attach CSV. Short charts only.
announce-bot: calendar_event: "Benchlab Blitz Webinar" scheduled 2024-07-18T16:00:00Z
Maya (content): Great. I'll write the launch post (short), Daniel will build the registration page, Priya will PR the README, Evan will push assets. Check-in Fri 9am PT. :thumbsup:
